note: STD-562: end-to-end vectors of the FR-483 check arm. Node ids are written $node:<label> and the harness derives each NodeId from the label, so no digest is frozen here. 'registry' is the descriptors, 'item' the request item as FR-290 reads it, 'negotiation' the FR-290 disposition, 'arm' the arm outcome and result for an item negotiated supported, 'outcome' the FR-331 outcome stage the provider writes, 'model' a value-validity claim the harness evaluates by enumeration, 'candidate' the assignment an engine reports as a violation, and 'replay' whether the native replay reproduces a refutation.

rekey.derivation: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the domain, a zero byte and the label, as lowercase hex
